method: Bounded read-only source inspection; no repository code executed, tests run, compilation, download, timing or repository edit.
scope: Existing pinned migration modules, selected authored conformance examples, current three registered matchers and source lowering. Not an exhaustive proof over every vendored nlohmann/json function.

candidates.reason: Input-dependent reads, helper calls, output writes, head/tail mutation, early stop and ordinary C unsigned arithmetic differ from the pure checked invariant reduction/full constant fill/byte swap rules. Current qualification targets the record-view safe core and Rust backend, not the NDU primitive Core path.
candidates.existing_workload: tools/fixtures/c_ring_buffer_benchmark.c mode 1: queue/dequeue 64 bytes through a 1024-byte ring; authored library-operation benchmark, no captured application trace or production hotness evidence.
candidates.possible_next_transform: New guarded bulk dequeue transformation with take=min(requested,(head-tail)&mask), at most two copies and final tail update; not an existing registered rule or an implemented candidate.
required_contracts: non-overlap of output, record and backing storage
valid capacity/head/tail domain including capacity one
unchanged output suffix and full backing bytes
exact returned count and persistent head/tail/pointer state
same wrapping arithmetic and external observation domain
verified adaptation from record-view migration to executable Core/native entry

candidates.reason: Complete retained comparison and hash-int modules have no qualifying loops, byte-view swap or constant fill.

Document.sum is authored adapter code with signed input-dependent values and JSON accessor/iterator calls; bounded contract can keep sum in range but does not make addend invariant. Bridge retains C++ implementation. No current-pass upstream hot function found in bounded review.

native_transform accumulates changing input bytes into record state and adjusts a floating field; not invariant unsigned reduction. Provenance explicitly disclaims independent production-library status.

Closest existing source-level full-fill operation. Standalone source lowering supports the concrete owner record, but evaluates for-loop len in preheader, whereas the fill matcher requires buffer.len in header. Each indexed store emits borrow.mut/store/loan.end, exceeding the exact three-op matcher body and adding real loan transitions. Existing cpp-owned LLVM qualification routes through llvm_owned_pipeline rather than NDU.
candidates.next_step: A separate source-to-Core integration task with explicit resource-observation preservation is required; do not erase/hoist per-iteration loan events merely to force matcher acceptance. No native artifact inequality or speedup is established.

notes: Ordinary unsigned C wrapping arithmetic cannot be relabeled checked arithmetic without preserving the accepted source contract.
Existing checksum loops in benchmark harnesses are not evidence for optimizing the actual library hot function.
Any new experiment must freeze source, domain, workload, budgets and selection rule before timing and retain failures/no-change.
